sloka: स तैः परिवृतः शूरैः सर्वतः स महाबलः ।आससादायसं भीमं परिघं तोरणाश्रितम्।स तं परिघमादय जघान रजनीचरान् ।। ५.४२.३९।।।।
transliteration: sa taiḥ parivṛtaḥ śūraiḥ sarvataḥ sa mahābalaḥ ।āsasādāyasaṁ bhīmaṁ parighaṁ toraṇāśritam।sa taṁ parighamādaya jaghāna rajanīcarān ।। 5.42.39।।।।

translations.english: Extremely powerful Hanuman surrounded by heroes all over, on his part went to the archway and picked up a terrific iron beam.
